people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
translations.bsb: O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!
translations.kjv: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
translations.asv: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: The God of Israel, he giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God. Psalm 69 For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshanim. A Psalm of David.
